title: Rust tests that block on a gate, barrier or channel must fail with a diagnosis on panic or deadlock instead of hanging the run
outcome: Rust tests that block on a gate, barrier or channel must fail with a diagnosis on panic or deadlock instead of hanging the run
acceptance: An inventory, cited to source, lists Rust tests whose worker threads block on a test-owned gate, barrier or channel that a panic on another thread would not release (for example a gate declared outside thread::scope)
Each listed test releases its blocked workers when the driving thread panics, so the test fails with its original panic instead of hanging
Where a wait has no release path on failure, it gains one that fails with a diagnosis; no timeout is inflated, no assertion weakened, and raw low CPU is not used as an automatic kill criterion
